page: Microsoft Azure D16nlds_v6 is a network-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Dnldv6 server family. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, this instance features 16 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a low memory-to-CPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The server is provisioned on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor and includes 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It is also capable of utilizing Premium Storage for external disk requirements.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and network-optimized design, the D16nlds_v6 is engineered for workloads requiring high packet processing and network throughput without massive memory footprints. The inclusion of a 945 GB local NVMe SSD provides high-speed temporary storage, reducing the need for external storage attachments for transient data. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the low memory-to-CPU ratio makes this instance a resource-dense option for compute-heavy tasks that do not require large RAM allocations, avoiding the premium associated with memory-optimized configurations. This hardware profile is suited for network appliances, web serving, CI/CD pipelines, and distributed compute nodes.
